 Anthony Edwards to Undergo Surgery on Knee Injury, Latest Rumors on Wolves Star's Return Timeline
 Julia Stumbaugh Oct 27, 2026 Minnesota Timberwolves star guard Anthony Edwards will miss "up to two months" after undergoing arthroscopic right knee surgery, ESPN's Shams Charania reported Tuesday.
 Edwards was previously listed as questionable due to right knee injury management ahead of a Wednesday night game against the Golden State Warriors.
